environmental enrichment (EE) reduced the corticosterone and dopaminergic responses to stress in PFC, and enhanced GRs mRNA expression in PFC, while EE reduced the spatial working memory and inhibitory responses to stress in rats.
environmental enrichment modulates the stress response and the behavioral responses to stressful situations in the adult male rat.
the environmental enrichment and isolation conditions have a different impact on the hormonal and the neurotransmitters responses to an acute restraint stress in PFC of awake rats.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the modulation of the neuroendocrine and neurochemical responses of PFC in rats exposed to environmental enrichment and isolation.
the neurobiological bases of the effects of environmental conditions in the stress responses, and the putative mechanisms underlying these changes.
the effects of environmental conditions on stress responses, and the putative neurobiologically related mechanisms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
environmental enrichment is a powerful tool to modulate the neurochemical and neuroendocrine responses to stress in adult rats.
EC and IC conditions differentially modulate the hormonal and neurotransmitter responses to stress in PFC, and these effects are related to the behavioral performance of the rats.

the environmental enrichment is able to induce changes on the neurochemical, endocrine and behavioral responses to stress in a way that may be related to the improvement of working and emotional memory in the adult rat.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
EC rats showed a better coping during stress, which could be related to a better performance in working memory tasks.
the environmental enrichment could improve the coping with stress, through the modulation of the neuroendocrine and neurochemical responses in the PFC.

environmental enrichment could improve the neurochemical and neuroendocrine responses to acute stress, and the behavioral responses to a stressful event, related to the prefrontal cortical functions, in adult rats.
The main takeaway from our work is that
environmental enrichment has differential effects on the stress response in the PFC and that this is accompanied by changes in the GRs and behavioral responses to stress.
environmental enrichment has the ability to modulate the stress responses in the PFC and to improve the cognitive performance of adult rats.
the environmental conditions can modulate the neurobiological responses to stress in an age-dependent manner.
